**Faction Tactics 1.0.2 (hybrid)** — server writes squad intents to ZDOs; **players install the Client DLL** so combat stays client-owned (no sticky-server statues).

Includes Meadows **Death-Rush** (Greylings bee-line charge) plus Roman / Ambush / VikingShieldWall / Steppe / PackHunters / ArtilleryJelly / InsectSiege / CharredLegion + Siege Assault v1. Behavior-only — no extra spawns.

1. Server: BepInEx 5 + `FactionTactics-Server.zip` → `BepInEx/plugins/FactionTactics.dll`
2. Everyone who joins: `FactionTactics-Client.zip` → `FactionTactics.Client.dll`
3. Same **1.0.2** on both sides (mismatch fails loudly in log)
